conflicts.fact: Wave type of FM radio signal vs. who is right: Lesson 11 and Lesson 4 aside, the explanation of why FM fades in the tunnel differs: diffraction only vs. diffraction plus interference/standing waves vs. refraction/TIR
conflicts.versions: Lessons 6, 12 and 10 attribute FM fade solely to diffraction (L10 explicitly says it is not TIR); Lessons 7, 9 and 11 add interference/standing-wave dead-zones as a second mechanism; Lesson 10 Model Building has students draw FM undergoing TIR at the tunnel wall, contradicting its own Explain phase and Lessons 6/12.

conflicts.fact: Tunnel width and AM wavelength used in Lesson 9 Model Building
conflicts.versions: Lessons 1, 5, 6, 12, and 9's own Explain use tunnel opening ~8 m and AM λ ≈ 529 m. Lesson 9's Model Building teacher script uses AM ≈ 300 m and tunnel mouth ≈ 4 m, and annotates 'FM: gap ≈ 1.4λ', 'AM: gap ≈ 0.013λ' versus the Explain phase's gap/λ ≈ 2.8 and 0.015.

conflicts.fact: Kabete tunnel dimension: length ~120 m vs. earlier treatment; also the claim that FM fits standing wave while diffraction rule 'gap vs wavelength'
conflicts.versions: Lesson 11 introduces tunnel length ~120 m and says AM can't form standing waves; Lesson 6 and 12 say AM diffracts because λ is larger than the 8 m opening. Lesson 11 also refers to diffraction as Lesson 10, whereas diffraction was Lesson 6 (and 9); Lesson 10 is refraction.
Lesson 1 gives FM ~2.9 m; Lessons 3, 4, 5, 6 give ~2.85 m.

conflicts.fact: Duplicate/conflicting lesson sequence on the wave equation v=fλ and wave types, with different numbering of unit model start
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 and Lesson 5 both teach v = fλ with FM/AM calculations; Lesson 4 also applies v=fλ. Lesson 2 says the Running Wave Model starts in Lesson 2, Lesson 5 says the cumulative model began in Lesson 1, Lesson 6/7/8 say begun in Lesson 2.

conflicts.fact: Sound wave type: Lesson 2 teaches only transverse waves as having crests/troughs and uses sound as a wave example, while Lesson 4 teaches sound is longitudinal; Lesson 3 uses sonar/wavelength
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 learned: transverse waves have crests, troughs; Lesson 4: matatu horn is longitudinal, FM transverse EM wave.

Lesson 9 says earlier lessons added reflection and refraction annotations to the tunnel scene, but refraction is first taught in Lesson 10 and reflection is never taught before; Lesson 8 says the thread will be completed in Lesson 12 and says guitar question was posted in Lesson 2 though Lesson 2 DQB themes did not include it.

conflicts.fact: Antenna/dipole lengths and AM station fade conclusion
conflicts.versions: Lesson 8 states FM dipole ~1.4 m and AM dipole ~264 m, the latter inconsistent with half of 529 m... (half-wave 264 m okay) but claims antenna size explains tunnel behavior, which conflicts with diffraction-based explanation in Lessons 6/12.
